additional_info.subject: RE: ID0410499-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / S0 170004104] Fw not getting pushed out and OCPP is offline CRM:00642002113
additional_info.body:
Hello Magnus,
Hope you are doing great.
As per the reported issue, we have updated the charger to the latest firmware version v6.0.3 remotely via SSH. Unfortunately, due to poor SCB connectivity, we are unable to fetch data from the router to check the OCPP router connection remotely. Could you please check the SCB connectivity as soon as possible? If resolving the SCB connectivity issue takes time, can we close this case for now? Once the SCB connection is stable, you can create a new case for the OCPP-related issue.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Mohini
